done_when: When a three-rounds stop gets no answer in 30 minutes, Forge records the repo's default choice (narrow to the Done-when lines and file each open finding as a follow-up fix, set once in forge.toml and on by default for new and upgraded repos), carries on, and the owner can reverse it later

findings.body: Raise: Functional. `forge land` starts the worker after recording the timed default, and this choice is put into the worker brief only when that round starts. If the owner then records `--resolve split` while the worker is running, the current worker never receives the split instruction. Land can accept a clean review and merge without starting another worker round, despite reporting that the owner's choice was recorded. This is a normal minutes-long window; `test_5` covers only a reversal made before `forge work` starts.
findings.title: Owner reversal during an active worker round is ignored

why: A three-rounds stop waits for the owner overnight, 6 to 8 hours each time, while nothing moves
